role.en: Assistant Professor, Princeton; Chief Scientist, Together AI
role.zh: 普林斯顿大学助理教授；Together AI 首席科学家

why.en: Author of the FlashAttention series — nearly every modern large model's training and inference depends on his kernels. Co-author of Mamba.
why.zh: FlashAttention 系列作者，几乎所有现代大模型的训练与推理都依赖其内核实现。Mamba 共同作者。

title.en: Mamba-3: improved sequence modeling using state space principles
title.zh: Mamba-3：基于状态空间原理的改进序列建模

note.en: Designed with inference efficiency as the primary goal — a departure from Mamba-2's training-speed optimisation. Adds a more expressive recurrence formula, complex-valued state tracking, and a MIMO variant.
note.zh: 以推理效率为首要目标设计，与 Mamba-2 优化训练速度的取向相反。引入更具表达力的递归公式、复数值状态追踪与 MIMO 变体。

title.en: Mayank put in a crazy amount of work to get pretraining to work on 3 gens of Nvidia GPUs and 2 gens of TPUs! Very good model for such a small size
title.zh: Mayank put in a crazy amount of work to get pretraining to work on 3 gens of Nvidia GPUs and 2 gens of TPUs! Very good model for such a small size

note.en: Tri Dao praises Mayank's work getting a small model pretrained across three generations of Nvidia GPUs and two generations of TPUs.
note.zh: Tri Dao称赞Mayank在三代Nvidia GPU和两代TPU上完成小模型预训练的出色工作。

title.en: A lot more gpus coming for open models
title.zh: A lot more gpus coming for open models

note.en: Tri Dao said significantly more GPU capacity is coming for open-weight models.
note.zh: Tri Dao表示将有更多GPU算力投向开源模型。

title.en: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
title.zh: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games

note.en: Multi-institution benchmark of 70 games in which agents must discover hidden rules by experimentation; Dao is a co-author on the Princeton side.
note.zh: 多机构合作的基准，包含 70 个需要通过试验才能发现隐藏规则的游戏，Dao 以普林斯顿一方参与署名。

title.en: Dion3: Full-Stack Orthogonal Updates
title.zh: Dion3: Full-Stack Orthogonal Updates

note.en: Cuts the orthogonalization and communication overhead of Muon-style optimizers under sharded training; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 降低 Muon 类优化器在权重分片训练下的正交化与通信开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: I really like this new benchmark. Has the flavor of ARC-AGI3 but it’s pure text so you don’t have to worry about the vision capability
title.zh: I really like this new benchmark. Has the flavor of ARC-AGI3 but it’s pure text so you don’t have to worry about the vision capability

note.en: Praised a new text-only benchmark for having the flavor of ARC-AGI3 without the vision-capability confound.
note.zh: 称赞一个新的纯文本基准测试，兼具ARC-AGI3的风格但无需担心视觉能力带来的干扰。

title.en: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
title.zh: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning

note.en: Test-time search that operates over whole reasoning steps rather than tokens to cut inference cost; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 在完整推理步骤而非 token 层面进行测试时搜索，以降低推理开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: Putting LLM brain on robots -> 4x SOTA with no extra training. I’ve been very surprised by how well this works. The time for agents running on robots is comi
title.zh: Putting LLM brain on robots -> 4x SOTA with no extra training. I’ve been very surprised by how well this works. The time for agents running on robots is comi

note.en: Highlighted a result putting an LLM 'brain' on robots for a 4x state-of-the-art gain with no extra training.
note.zh: 强调了一项将LLM“大脑”用于机器人的成果，在无需额外训练的情况下取得4倍的性能提升。

title.en: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency
title.zh: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency

note.en: Princeton and Together AI paper on orchestrating perception, planning and control for generalist robots; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 普林斯顿与 Together AI 合作的论文，研究通用机器人中感知、规划与控制的编排问题，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: We’re serving 400T tokens / month and the demand for open models just keep going up
title.zh: We’re serving 400T tokens / month and the demand for open models just keep going up

note.en: Shared that Together AI is now serving 400 trillion tokens per month, with demand for open models still rising.
note.zh: 分享Together AI现在每月处理400万亿token，开源模型的需求仍在持续增长。

title.en: If you ever wondered about how how open/closed model makers and inference providers make economic sense, this is the piece to read
title.zh: If you ever wondered about how how open/closed model makers and inference providers make economic sense, this is the piece to read

note.en: Recommended an analysis piece on the economics behind open/closed model makers and inference providers.
note.zh: 推荐了一篇分析开源/闭源模型厂商与推理服务商经济模式的文章。

title.en: It's wild how quickly Etched designed and got the chips out, all within 2 years. They went deep, hardcoding attention into silicon and getting very high MFU. Th
title.zh: It's wild how quickly Etched designed and got the chips out, all within 2 years. They went deep, hardcoding attention into silicon and getting very high MFU. Th

note.en: Praised Etched for shipping attention-hardcoded silicon within two years, achieving very high MFU.
note.zh: 称赞Etched在两年内推出将注意力机制硬编码进芯片的产品，实现了很高的MFU。

title.en: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
title.zh: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State

note.en: His own write-up of ReplaySSM, a decoding scheme that caches recent SSM inputs instead of writing recurrent state back to HBM at every step.
note.zh: 他本人撰文介绍 ReplaySSM：解码时缓存最近的输入，而不必每一步都把循环状态写回 HBM。

title.en: As hybrid models (Qwen 3.5 / Nemotron Ultra) run agents with massive context, Gated-DeltaNet / Mamba states become a bottleneck. A simple insight to make this 2
title.zh: As hybrid models (Qwen 3.5 / Nemotron Ultra) run agents with massive context, Gated-DeltaNet / Mamba states become a bottleneck. A simple insight to make this 2

note.en: Explained that as hybrid models run agents with massive context, Mamba/Gated-DeltaNet state loading becomes a bottleneck, and described a fix that makes it 2x faster.
note.zh: 解释了混合模型在长上下文agent场景中Mamba/Gated-DeltaNet状态加载成为瓶颈的问题，并介绍了一个使其提速2倍的方法。

title.en: SonicSampler: Unified Tile-Aware Kernels for LLM Sampling and Speculative Verification
title.zh: SonicSampler: Unified Tile-Aware Kernels for LLM Sampling and Speculative Verification

note.en: Fused tile-aware GPU kernels covering LLM sampling and speculative-decoding verification; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 为 LLM 采样与投机解码验证设计的融合式 tile 感知 GPU 内核，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: After some mathematical rewrite, turns out all of transformer is a series of gemm + epilogue. Given a few optimized primitives, LLMs (and novice humans) can wri
title.zh: After some mathematical rewrite, turns out all of transformer is a series of gemm + epilogue. Given a few optimized primitives, LLMs (and novice humans) can wri

note.en: Described a mathematical rewrite showing the transformer reduces to a series of gemm + epilogue operations, letting LLMs write speed-of-light kernels.
note.zh: 介绍了一种数学重写方法，表明整个transformer可归结为一系列gemm+epilogue运算，使LLM能够写出极速内核。

title.en: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs
title.zh: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs

note.en: Rewrites transformer blocks as GEMM-epilogue programs to remove memory-bound overhead in training; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 把 Transformer 模块改写为 GEMM 尾声程序，消除训练中的访存瓶颈，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: Search Your Block Floating Point Scales!
title.zh: Search Your Block Floating Point Scales!

note.en: Searches block-floating-point scale factors to improve low-precision inference on newer GPU formats; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 搜索块浮点的缩放因子，以改善新一代 GPU 低精度格式下的推理效果，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: SonicMoE: A Hardware-Efficient and Software-Extensible Blueprint for Fine-Grained MoEs
title.zh: SonicMoE: A Hardware-Efficient and Software-Extensible Blueprint for Fine-Grained MoEs

note.en: His blog post on SonicMoE, a Blackwell-oriented design for fine-grained mixture-of-experts that holds activation memory flat as expert granularity rises.
note.zh: 他的博客文章介绍 SonicMoE：一种面向 Blackwell 的细粒度 MoE 设计，在专家粒度提高时仍能保持激活显存不增长。

title.en: @WentaoGuo7 explains really well this nice mathematical rewrite of the MoE backward. This leads to much lower activation mem, and way faster speed, esp for fine
title.zh: @WentaoGuo7 explains really well this nice mathematical rewrite of the MoE backward. This leads to much lower activation mem, and way faster speed, esp for fine

note.en: Highlighted a mathematical rewrite of the MoE backward pass that lowers activation memory and speeds up fine-grained MoE training.
note.zh: 介绍了一种MoE反向传播的数学重写方法，降低了激活内存占用并加快了细粒度MoE训练速度。

title.en: SAW-INT4: System-Aware 4-Bit KV-Cache Quantization for Real-World LLM Serving
title.zh: SAW-INT4: System-Aware 4-Bit KV-Cache Quantization for Real-World LLM Serving

note.en: System-aware 4-bit KV-cache quantization for LLM serving that mixes latency- and throughput-sensitive traffic; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 面向同时承载低延迟与高吞吐请求的 LLM 服务的系统感知 4-bit KV 缓存量化方案，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: The dynamical system view gives very clean conditions for looped transformer to be stable
title.zh: The dynamical system view gives very clean conditions for looped transformer to be stable

note.en: Noted that a dynamical-systems view gives clean stability conditions for looped transformers.
note.zh: 指出从动力系统的视角可以给出循环transformer稳定性的简洁条件。

title.en: Introspective Diffusion Language Models
title.zh: Introspective Diffusion Language Models

note.en: Attributes the quality gap of diffusion language models to inconsistent self-scoring and proposes a fix; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 把扩散语言模型的质量差距归因于自评一致性不足并给出改进方案，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: Squeeze Evolve: Unified Multi-Model Orchestration for Verifier-Free Evolution
title.zh: Squeeze Evolve: Unified Multi-Model Orchestration for Verifier-Free Evolution

note.en: Multi-model orchestration for verifier-free evolutionary search, tackling diversity collapse and compute cost; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 面向无验证器演化搜索的多模型编排方法，缓解多样性坍缩与算力开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: Fast muon optimizer coming to consumer cards. All the code was written as matmul + epilogue so once the mainloop was implemented for Blackwell consumer cards, a
title.zh: Fast muon optimizer coming to consumer cards. All the code was written as matmul + epilogue so once the mainloop was implemented for Blackwell consumer cards, a

note.en: Announced a fast Muon optimizer implementation coming to consumer GPU cards, built on a matmul+epilogue kernel design.
note.zh: 宣布基于matmul+epilogue内核设计的快速Muon优化器实现即将登陆消费级GPU显卡。

title.en: Gram Newton-Schulz: A Fast, Hardware-Aware Newton-Schulz Algorithm for Muon
title.zh: Gram Newton-Schulz: A Fast, Hardware-Aware Newton-Schulz Algorithm for Muon

note.en: His post on a hardware-aware Newton-Schulz variant that cuts the per-step cost of Muon, the optimizer now used to train models like Kimi K2 Thinking and GLM-5.
note.zh: 他撰文提出一种硬件友好的 Newton-Schulz 变体，降低 Muon 优化器的单步开销——Kimi K2 Thinking、GLM-5 等模型的训练都在使用该优化器。

title.en: It's my favorite kind of work: linear algebra insight + fast kernels. When playing w Muon a while ago, we were thinking why not speed it up by operating on the
title.zh: It's my favorite kind of work: linear algebra insight + fast kernels. When playing w Muon a while ago, we were thinking why not speed it up by operating on the

note.en: Shared a linear-algebra insight for speeding up the Muon optimizer by operating on a small square matrix instead of the full one.
note.zh: 分享了一个加速Muon优化器的线性代数思路：对一个小方阵而非完整矩阵进行运算。

title.en: Nonlinear RNNs seem to do sth genuinely different from attn and linear RNNs/SSMs. By themselves they already do quite well w the right parametrization, but just
title.zh: Nonlinear RNNs seem to do sth genuinely different from attn and linear RNNs/SSMs. By themselves they already do quite well w the right parametrization, but just

note.en: Argued nonlinear RNNs behave genuinely differently from attention and linear RNNs/SSMs, and can substantially help when combined with them.
note.zh: 认为非线性RNN与注意力机制及线性RNN/SSM有本质不同，与后者结合时能带来显著提升。

title.en: The frontier has increasingly shifted to hybrid models - from Qwen to Kimi-Linear and now with NVIDIA's Nemotron-3 Super - that rely on a strong linear sequence
title.zh: The frontier has increasingly shifted to hybrid models - from Qwen to Kimi-Linear and now with NVIDIA's Nemotron-3 Super - that rely on a strong linear sequence

note.en: Announced the release of Mamba-3, positioning it within the industry shift toward hybrid models with strong linear sequence components.
note.zh: 宣布发布Mamba-3，并将其置于行业转向强线性序列组件混合模型的趋势中。

title.en: Mamba-3 Part 1
title.zh: Mamba-3 Part 1

note.en: Part 1 of his Mamba-3 series, introducing the next generation of the state space architecture he co-created.
note.zh: 他的 Mamba-3 系列第一篇，介绍这一由他共同提出的状态空间架构的新一代版本。

title.en: Mamba-3 Part 2 - Methodological Deep Dive
title.zh: Mamba-3 Part 2 - Methodological Deep Dive

note.en: Part 2 of his Mamba-3 series, a methodological deep dive into how the new architecture is derived.
note.zh: 他的 Mamba-3 系列第二篇，深入拆解新架构的方法论推导过程。

title.en: M$^2$RNN: Non-Linear RNNs with Matrix-Valued States for Scalable Language Modeling
title.zh: M$^2$RNN: Non-Linear RNNs with Matrix-Valued States for Scalable Language Modeling

note.en: Non-linear RNN with matrix-valued state aimed at tasks beyond the expressivity limits of transformers; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 带矩阵值状态的非线性 RNN，面向超出 Transformer 表达能力上限的任务，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: FlashAttention-4: Algorithm and Kernel Pipelining Co-Design for Asymmetric Hardware Scaling
title.zh: FlashAttention-4: Algorithm and Kernel Pipelining Co-Design for Asymmetric Hardware Scaling

note.en: His announcement of FlashAttention-4, co-designing the attention algorithm with kernel pipelining for hardware whose compute and memory scale unevenly.
note.zh: 他发布 FlashAttention-4：将注意力算法与内核流水线协同设计，以适配算力与访存增长不匹配的硬件。

title.en: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade
title.zh: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade

note.en: Community roadmap report on the next decade of AI and hardware co-design, co-signed by Dao.
note.zh: 关于未来十年 AI 与硬件协同设计的社区路线图报告，Dao 为联合署名者之一。

title.en: The FA4 paper is finally out after a year of work. On Blackwell GPUs, attention now goes about as fast as matmul even though the bottlenecks are so different! T
title.zh: The FA4 paper is finally out after a year of work. On Blackwell GPUs, attention now goes about as fast as matmul even though the bottlenecks are so different! T

note.en: Released the FlashAttention 4 paper after a year of work, making attention run about as fast as matmul on Blackwell GPUs.
note.zh: 历时一年发布FlashAttention 4论文，使注意力计算在Blackwell GPU上达到接近矩阵乘法的速度。

title.en: Attack of the asynchronous machines. We’ve seen this a lot in GPU kernels. This time the same principle applies in speculative decoding
title.zh: Attack of the asynchronous machines. We’ve seen this a lot in GPU kernels. This time the same principle applies in speculative decoding

note.en: Drew an analogy between asynchronous GPU kernel techniques and applying the same principle to speculative decoding.
note.zh: 将GPU内核中的异步技术类比应用于投机解码，指出了相同的原理。

title.en: Speculative Speculative Decoding
title.zh: Speculative Speculative Decoding

note.en: Adds a second layer of speculation on top of speculative decoding to further cut sequential decode cost; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 在投机解码之上再叠加一层投机，进一步降低顺序解码开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: This was a wild bug hunt, weeks of effort from @MayankMish98 to track down. The wrong init of Mamba2 in many reimplementations causes the layer to decay its sta
title.zh: This was a wild bug hunt, weeks of effort from @MayankMish98 to track down. The wrong init of Mamba2 in many reimplementations causes the layer to decay its sta

note.en: Described a hard-to-find bug where incorrect initialization of Mamba2 in many reimplementations causes the layer to decay state too quickly in short contexts.
note.zh: 介绍了一个难以发现的bug：许多Mamba2的复现版本因初始化错误，导致状态在短上下文中过快衰减。

title.en: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System
title.zh: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System

note.en: Unified system that trains the speculator online during RL post-training instead of offline; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 把投机模型训练与 RL 后训练服务打通，在线而非离线更新投机器，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: This is what we've been coking for the last 9 months: make MoEs training goes ~2x faster and ~2x less memory! Highlights: - MoE typically takes the most time an
title.zh: This is what we've been coking for the last 9 months: make MoEs training goes ~2x faster and ~2x less memory! Highlights: - MoE typically takes the most time an

note.en: Announced work making MoE training roughly 2x faster and using 2x less memory, the product of nine months of effort.
note.zh: 宣布了历时九个月的成果：让MoE训练速度提升约2倍，内存占用降低约2倍。

title.en: SonicMoE: Accelerating MoE with IO and Tile-aware Optimizations
title.zh: SonicMoE: Accelerating MoE with IO and Tile-aware Optimizations

note.en: IO- and tile-aware kernels that accelerate mixture-of-experts models; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 面向 MoE 模型的 IO 与 tile 感知内核优化，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: Nvidia continues to put out some of the strongest and fastest open models. Pretraining and post training data are released as well, something very few orgs have
title.zh: Nvidia continues to put out some of the strongest and fastest open models. Pretraining and post training data are released as well, something very few orgs have

note.en: Praised Nvidia for releasing some of the strongest and fastest open models along with pretraining and post-training data, which few labs do.
note.zh: 称赞英伟达发布了业内最强、最快的开源模型之一，并罕见地开放了预训练和后训练数据。

title.en: Beat the long tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training
title.zh: Beat the long tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training

note.en: Distribution-aware speculative decoding that speeds up the rollout phase of RL post-training; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 用分布感知的投机解码加速 RL 后训练中的 rollout 阶段，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: Thank you @schmidtsciences for the 2025 #AI2050 Early Career Fellowship supporting my work on self-improving AI systems: as AI gets better, it should help human
title.zh: Thank you @schmidtsciences for the 2025 #AI2050 Early Career Fellowship supporting my work on self-improving AI systems: as AI gets better, it should help human

note.en: Announced receiving the 2026 AI2050 Early Career Fellowship from Schmidt Sciences to support his work on self-improving AI systems.
note.zh: 宣布获得施密特科学基金会2026年AI2050早期职业奖学金，用于支持其自我改进AI系统方面的研究。

title.en: Opportunistic Expert Activation: Batch-Aware Expert Routing for Faster Decode Without Retraining
title.zh: Opportunistic Expert Activation: Batch-Aware Expert Routing for Faster Decode Without Retraining

note.en: Batch-aware expert routing that speeds up mixture-of-experts decoding without retraining; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 无需重新训练的批次感知专家路由，加快 MoE 模型的解码速度，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: This work, led by @_junxiong_wang and @ben_athi, is a first step towards building AI systems that evolve and get better as you use them. More to come!
title.zh: This work, led by @_junxiong_wang and @ben_athi, is a first step towards building AI systems that evolve and get better as you use them. More to come!

note.en: Announced work led by two collaborators as a first step toward AI systems that evolve and improve as they are used.
note.zh: 宣布由两名合作者主导的一项工作，是迈向能在使用过程中自我进化改进的AI系统的第一步。

title.en: Ep 74: Chief Scientist of Together.AI Tri Dao On The End of Nvidia's Dominance, Why Inference Costs Fell & The Next 10X in Speed
title.zh: Ep 74: Chief Scientist of Together.AI Tri Dao On The End of Nvidia's Dominance, Why Inference Costs Fell & The Next 10X in Speed

note.en: Long-form interview in which he argues Nvidia's dominance is ending and explains where the next 10x in inference speed will come from.
note.zh: 长篇访谈：他认为英伟达的主导地位正在终结，并解释推理速度下一个 10 倍将从何而来。

title.en: Clarification: I was comparing A @ B + C here, where the cute-dsl version is quite good at overlapping the epilogue. On the standard matmul A @ B, cuBLAS is ver
title.zh: Clarification: I was comparing A @ B + C here, where the cute-dsl version is quite good at overlapping the epilogue. On the standard matmul A @ B, cuBLAS is ver

note.en: Clarified a benchmark comparison, noting cuBLAS remains very strong on standard matmul while the cute-dsl version overlaps the epilogue well for fused operations.
note.zh: 澄清了一项基准对比：在标准矩阵乘法上cuBLAS依然非常强，而cute-dsl版本在融合运算中能较好地重叠epilogue。

title.en: Hierarchical layout is super elegant. Feels like the right abstraction for high performance GPU kernels. FlashAttention 2 actually started bc we wanted to rewri
title.zh: Hierarchical layout is super elegant. Feels like the right abstraction for high performance GPU kernels. FlashAttention 2 actually started bc we wanted to rewri

note.en: Called CuTe's hierarchical layout an elegant abstraction for GPU kernels, and shared that FlashAttention 2 originated from wanting to rewrite FA1 in CuTe.
note.zh: 称CuTe的层次化布局是GPU内核的优雅抽象，并透露FlashAttention 2正是源于想用CuTe重写FA1。

title.en: I played w it for 1h. Went through my usual prompts (math derivations, floating point optimizations, …). It’s a good model, feels comparable to the best frontie
title.zh: I played w it for 1h. Went through my usual prompts (math derivations, floating point optimizations, …). It’s a good model, feels comparable to the best frontie

note.en: Gave a hands-on assessment after an hour testing a new model on his usual prompts, calling it comparable to the best frontier models.
note.zh: 用惯用的提示词测试了一款新模型一小时后给出评价，认为其表现可与最强的前沿模型媲美。

title.en: They’ve finally done it. They got rid of tokenizers!
title.zh: They’ve finally done it. They got rid of tokenizers!

note.en: Highlighted a notable milestone: a model that has done away with tokenizers entirely.
note.zh: 强调了一个重要进展：一款完全摒弃了分词器的模型。

title.en: Getting mem-bound kernels to speed-of-light isn't a dark art, it's just about getting the a couple of details right. We wrote a tutorial on how to do this, with
title.zh: Getting mem-bound kernels to speed-of-light isn't a dark art, it's just about getting the a couple of details right. We wrote a tutorial on how to do this, with

note.en: Announced a tutorial, with usable code, on getting memory-bound GPU kernels to speed-of-light performance.
note.zh: 发布了一份关于如何将内存受限的GPU内核优化到极速性能的教程，并附有可直接使用的代码。

title.en: Albert articulates really well the trade offs between transformers and SSMs. This is why I work on both
title.zh: Albert articulates really well the trade offs between transformers and SSMs. This is why I work on both

note.en: Endorsed a colleague's articulation of the tradeoffs between transformers and SSMs, explaining why he works on both.
note.zh: 认可了一位同事对transformer与SSM之间权衡的阐述，并解释了自己为何同时研究这两者。

title.en: Turns out you can do length generalization for recurrent model by simply training for another extra 100 steps with a careful choice of initial states
title.zh: Turns out you can do length generalization for recurrent model by simply training for another extra 100 steps with a careful choice of initial states

note.en: Shared a finding that recurrent models can achieve length generalization with just ~100 extra training steps and careful choice of initial states.
note.zh: 分享了一项发现：只需约100步额外训练并谨慎选择初始状态，循环模型即可实现长度泛化。

title.en: Crazy that we now have an open source model with 13B params that’s competitive w o1. And Mamba layers help bring much higher inference throughput
title.zh: Crazy that we now have an open source model with 13B params that’s competitive w o1. And Mamba layers help bring much higher inference throughput

note.en: Noted a 13B-parameter open-source model now competitive with o1, with Mamba layers boosting inference throughput.
note.zh: 指出一款130亿参数的开源模型已能与o1媲美，其中Mamba层显著提升了推理吞吐量。

title.en: Albert and co continue to do excellent work on quantization. This time the trick is to minimize KL wrt the original model, with a clever hessian factorization
title.zh: Albert and co continue to do excellent work on quantization. This time the trick is to minimize KL wrt the original model, with a clever hessian factorization

note.en: Praised ongoing quantization work minimizing KL divergence to the original model via a clever Hessian factorization.
note.zh: 称赞了一项通过巧妙的Hessian分解、以最小化与原模型KL散度为目标的量化研究。

title.en: Sparse attn has been around for a while, but test time compute might be the era where it really shines
title.zh: Sparse attn has been around for a while, but test time compute might be the era where it really shines

note.en: Argued sparse attention, though not new, may finally shine in the test-time-compute era.
note.zh: 认为稀疏注意力机制虽非新技术，但在测试时计算的时代可能会真正发挥优势。

title.en: State space models and RNNs compress history into a constant size state, while attn has KV cache scaling linearly in seqlen. We can instead start from RNNs and
title.zh: State space models and RNNs compress history into a constant size state, while attn has KV cache scaling linearly in seqlen. We can instead start from RNNs and

note.en: Explained how SSMs/RNNs compress history into constant-size state versus attention's linearly scaling KV cache, and proposed letting state size grow logarithmically instead.
note.zh: 解释了SSM/RNN将历史压缩为固定大小状态、而注意力的KV缓存随序列长度线性增长的区别，并提出让状态大小按对数增长的思路。

title.en: Log-Linear Attention
title.zh: Log-Linear Attention

note.en: Attention variant with logarithmically growing state, sitting between linear attention and full attention; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 状态规模按对数增长的注意力变体，介于线性注意力与完整注意力之间，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: We've been thinking about what the "ideal" architecture should look like in the era where inference is driving AI progress. GTA & GLA are steps in this directio
title.zh: We've been thinking about what the "ideal" architecture should look like in the era where inference is driving AI progress. GTA & GLA are steps in this directio

note.en: Introduced GTA and GLA as steps toward an 'ideal' architecture for the era where inference efficiency drives AI progress.
note.zh: 介绍了GTA和GLA架构，作为在推理效率驱动AI进步的时代迈向“理想”架构的探索。

title.en: Hardware-Efficient Attention for Fast Decoding
title.zh: Hardware-Efficient Attention for Fast Decoding

note.en: Attention designs that cut KV-cache loading and speed up large-batch, long-context decoding; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 提出减少 KV 缓存读取的注意力设计，加快大批量、长上下文场景下的解码，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: Long-Context State-Space Video World Models
title.zh: Long-Context State-Space Video World Models

note.en: Uses state-space layers to give video world models long-term memory; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 用状态空间层为视频世界模型提供长期记忆能力，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: Congrats to @ruipeterpan and the entire team for the recognition of Marconi at MLSys. Hybrid mamba-transformer LLMs are getting more popular, and the change in
title.zh: Congrats to @ruipeterpan and the entire team for the recognition of Marconi at MLSys. Hybrid mamba-transformer LLMs are getting more popular, and the change in

note.en: Congratulated the team on Marconi's recognition at MLSys, noting hybrid mamba-transformer LLMs are becoming more popular as compute/cache ratios shift.
note.zh: 祝贺团队的Marconi项目在MLSys获得认可，并指出随着算力/缓存比例的变化，混合mamba-transformer大模型正变得越来越流行。

title.en: I love Cutlass, and this new Python DSL looks very well-designed. Will for sure accelerate kernel dev + exploring new ideas in ML + GPU. I'm already playing wit
title.zh: I love Cutlass, and this new Python DSL looks very well-designed. Will for sure accelerate kernel dev + exploring new ideas in ML + GPU. I'm already playing wit

note.en: Praised a new well-designed Python DSL for Cutlass, expecting it to accelerate kernel development and ML/GPU exploration.
note.zh: 称赞一款设计精良的Cutlass Python DSL，认为它将加速内核开发和ML/GPU方面的探索。

title.en: The IBM team continues to do excellent work on data and model architecture. Surpassing Llama3 8B with 5x less data!
title.zh: The IBM team continues to do excellent work on data and model architecture. Surpassing Llama3 8B with 5x less data!

note.en: Praised IBM's team for surpassing Llama3 8B using 5x less training data through better data and architecture.
note.zh: 称赞IBM团队通过更优的数据和架构，用少5倍的数据超越了Llama3 8B。

title.en: M1: Towards Scalable Test-Time Compute with Mamba Reasoning Models
title.zh: M1: Towards Scalable Test-Time Compute with Mamba Reasoning Models

note.en: Mamba-based reasoning model that scales test-time compute more cheaply than transformer baselines; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 基于 Mamba 的推理模型，在扩展测试时计算上比 Transformer 基线更省算力，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: Thinking Slow, Fast: Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
title.zh: Thinking Slow, Fast: Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners

note.en: Distills transformer reasoners into subquadratic models so test-time compute scaling stays cheap; Dao is senior author.
note.zh: 把 Transformer 推理模型蒸馏到次二次架构，使测试时计算的扩展更廉价，Dao 为通讯作者。

title.en: HybriDNA: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba2 Long-Range DNA Language Model
title.zh: HybriDNA: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba2 Long-Range DNA Language Model

note.en: Hybrid transformer-Mamba2 DNA language model for long genomic sequences; Dao is a co-author.
note.zh: 面向长基因组序列的 Transformer-Mamba2 混合 DNA 语言模型，Dao 为共同作者。

title.en: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
title.zh: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision

note.en: His announcement of FlashAttention-3, which uses Hopper's asynchrony and low precision to speed up attention without approximation.
note.zh: 他发布 FlashAttention-3：利用 Hopper 的异步执行与低精度，在不做近似的前提下加速注意力计算。

title.en: State Space Duality (Mamba-2) Part I - The Model
title.zh: State Space Duality (Mamba-2) Part I - The Model

note.en: Part I of his state space duality series, presenting the Mamba-2 model.
note.zh: 他的状态空间对偶系列第一篇，提出 Mamba-2 模型。

title.en: State Space Duality (Mamba-2) Part II - The Theory
title.zh: State Space Duality (Mamba-2) Part II - The Theory

note.en: Part II of the same series, setting out the theory that links state space models and attention.
note.zh: 同一系列第二篇，阐述将状态空间模型与注意力联系起来的理论。

title.en: State Space Duality (Mamba-2) Part III - The Algorithm
title.zh: State Space Duality (Mamba-2) Part III - The Algorithm

note.en: Part III of the same series, giving the algorithm that makes the state space duality view efficient to compute.
note.zh: 同一系列第三篇，给出让状态空间对偶视角得以高效计算的算法。

title.en: Interviewing Tri Dao and Michael Poli of Together AI on the future of LLM architectures
title.zh: Interviewing Tri Dao and Michael Poli of Together AI on the future of LLM architectures

note.en: Interview with Nathan Lambert, alongside Michael Poli, on where LLM architectures are heading beyond the Transformer.
note.zh: 他与 Michael Poli 一同接受 Nathan Lambert 访谈，讨论 Transformer 之后大模型架构的走向。

title.en: FlashAttention 2: making Transformers 800% faster w/o approximation - with Tri Dao of Together AI
title.zh: FlashAttention 2: making Transformers 800% faster w/o approximation - with Tri Dao of Together AI

posts.source: Latent Space: The AI Engineer Podcast

note.en: Interview on FlashAttention-2, the kernel work that made Transformer attention several times faster with no approximation.
note.zh: 关于 FlashAttention-2 的访谈：这项内核工作在不做近似的情况下将 Transformer 注意力提速数倍。

title.en: Mamba-3 published at ICLR 2026
title.zh: Mamba-3 发表于 ICLR 2026

body.en: A collaboration with CMU, Princeton and Together AI.
body.zh: CMU、普林斯顿与 Together AI 的合作成果。
